description: Per-role context allowlist for feature-graph version 6 briefs. dag_run.py brief validates every input against this file and fails closed: unknown kinds, kinds not listed for the role, oversize inputs and oversize totals are rejected. Anything not listed is denied, including conversation history, HQ or hop history, subagent transcripts, other engineers' diffs and the architect's plan for gate reviewers.

spec_full.meaning: Frozen Linear spec at the pinned revision

spec_excerpt.meaning: Frozen spec clauses relevant to one work package

acceptance_checks.meaning: Acceptance checks only, no spec narrative

package.meaning: One work package: owner, owned files, responsibilities, acceptance checks

contract.meaning: Interface contracts written by the architect

contract_interfaces.meaning: Read-only interfaces of contracts the package depends on

owned_files.meaning: The package's owned files at the baseline or its own worktree head

bounced_findings.meaning: Findings bounced to this engineer, verbatim and deduplicated; generated by dag_run.py

merged_diff.meaning: Merged integration diff against the baseline

worktree_list.meaning: Package worktrees and branches with head SHAs

merge_results.meaning: Git merge outcome: order, merged head, conflicts

git_request.meaning: One Git operation request: operation, repo or worktree, refs, constraints

subagent_summary.meaning: One subagent's returned summary or verdict, never a raw transcript
